svg.title: HRMate P2 Slice 3 — Staff Duty Roster mobile design proposal
svg.desc: Two proposed mobile screens: a staff-only weekly duty roster with department filters, per-day shift/off chips and a save bar, and a shift-swaps tab with approve/reject. All displayed data is illustrative. Implementation awaits approval.
svg.text: Staff board. Same cells as web. Phone layout.
Approval pending — not a live app screen
